UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Representa o perfil de um usuário na plataforma SafeStart Invest.

id.description: Identificador único para o perfil do usuário, correspondente ao UID do Firebase Auth.

perfilDeInvestimento.description: Informações do usuário relacionadas a investimentos.

valorInvestimento.description: O valor inicial que o usuário deseja investir.

avaliacaoDeRisco.description: Avaliação gerada por IA do perfil de risco do usuário (ex: Conservador, Moderado, Arrojado).

estrategiaDeInvestimento.description: Estratégia de investimento gerada por IA e adaptada ao usuário.

alocacaoDeAtivos.description: Alocação de ativos recomendada gerada por IA como uma string separada por vírgulas.

horizonteDeInvestimento.description: O horizonte de tempo de investimento do usuário, a partir do questionário.

metasFinanceiras.description: Metas financeiras declaradas pelo usuário, a partir do questionário.

experienciaDeInvestimento.description: Nível de experiência de investimento do usuário, a partir do questionário.

respostasQuestionario.description: Um resumo das respostas do usuário ao questionário de onboarding.

id.description: Unique identifier for the investment portfolio.

name.description: Name of the portfolio (e.g., 'Retirement Fund', 'Growth Portfolio').

creationDate.description: Date when the portfolio was created.

assetAllocation.description: JSON string representing the asset allocation of the portfolio (e.g., stocks, bonds, real estate). Generated by AI analysis of user profile.

EducationalTrail.title: EducationalTrail
EducationalTrail.description: Represents an educational trail for users to learn about investing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the educational trail.

description.description: Description of the educational trail's content.

modules.description: Array of modules within the educational trail.

BlogArticle.title: BlogArticle
BlogArticle.description: Represents a blog article about market trends and investment strategies.

id.description: Unique identifier for the blog article.

publishDate.description: Date when the blog article was published.

NextStepRecommendation.title: NextStepRecommendation
NextStepRecommendation.description: Represents a recommendation for the next step a user can take in their investment portfolio.

recommendationText.description: Text of the recommendation (e.g., 'Consider diversifying into international stocks'). Generated by AI.

dateGenerated.description: Date when the recommendation was generated.

UserProgress.title: UserProgress
UserProgress.description: Armazena o progresso de um usuário na trilha educacional gamificada.

currentLevelId.description: O ID do nível atual em que o usuário está.

currentLessonId.description: O ID da próxima lição que o usuário deve fazer.

xp.description: Total de pontos de experiência (XP) acumulados.

streakDays.description: Número de dias consecutivos de estudo (streak).

lastStudyDate.description: A data do último dia em que o usuário estudou. Nulo se nunca estudou.

completedLessons.description: Uma lista de IDs de todas as lições que o usuário já completou.

earnedBadges.description: Uma lista de IDs de todas as medalhas que o usuário já ganhou.

completedMissions.description: Uma lista de IDs de todas as missões que o usuário já completou.

ownedItems.description: Uma lista de IDs de todos os itens da loja que o usuário comprou.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the SafeStart Invest platform, focusing on user profiles, investment portfolios, educational content, and AI-driven recommendations. It prioritizes authorization independence, clear access patterns, and scalability.

**Authorization Independence & QAPs:**

*   User-owned data (UserProfile, InvestmentPortfolio, NextStepRecommendation) is stored under `/users/{userId}` collections. This leverages path-based authorization, eliminating the need for `get()` calls in security rules and enabling atomic operations. This structure inherently supports QAPs by allowing secure listing of user-specific data without complex filtering.
*   EducationalTrail and BlogArticle collections are top-level, implying public read access. Segregation ensures different security postures are not mixed, simplifying security rules.

**Structure Overview:**

*   `/users/{userId}/userProfiles/{profileId}`: Stores user profile information. The `userId` in the path ensures that only the authenticated user can access their profile. Since the userId is available in the path there is no need to store it in the document itself.
*   `/users/{userId}/investmentPortfolios/{portfolioId}`: Stores investment portfolios owned by a specific user. The `userId` in the path guarantees ownership, enabling secure listing. The `portfolioId` is used to uniquely identify each portfolio.
*   `/users/{userId}/investmentPortfolios/{portfolioId}/nextStepRecommendations/{recommendationId}`: Stores AI-generated next-step recommendations for a specific portfolio. The nested structure under `/users/{userId}/investmentPortfolios/{portfolioId}` ensures that only the owner of the portfolio can access these recommendations. This maintains the hierarchical ownership and simplifies security rules.
*   `/educationalTrails/{educationalTrailId}`: Stores educational trails available to all users. This is a top-level collection for globally accessible data.
*   `/blogArticles/{blogArticleId}`: Stores blog articles accessible to all users. This is a top-level collection for globally accessible data.
